$comment: Curated description of source-assets/product_list (source photos, never modified). Label text is transcribed verbatim from the packaging photos; anything not visible is listed under `flags` instead of being guessed. Prices and stock are intentionally absent: every product imports as a draft and is priced in the admin. `labelMrp` / `labelNetWeight` are what the pack prints, for reference only.

prey.name: PREY
prey.story: PREY is a masterclass in ancestral nutrition. We stripped away the noise—no grains, no soy, and absolutely zero artificial nasties—leaving only the raw essence of farm-fresh, 100% human-grade ingredients. It is a single-minded commitment to universal goodness, gently dehydrated to lock in the untamed vitality your companion was born to crave.
prey.storage: Once opened, store the pack in a cool & dry place. Away from the direct sunlight.
advisory: Do not feed to pets below 12 weeks.
Please check ingredients for possible allergens.
prey.bestBefore: 18 months from the date of manufacturing
prey.packedAndMarketedBy: The Nuzz Story C-17 GF Right Side, Nagal Dewat, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi- 110070.

krunch.name: KRUNCH
krunch.story: KRUNCH redefines the daily reward for dogs of every breed. We bake farm-fresh, human-grade ingredients into a pristine, gluten-free and soy-free recipe with absolutely zero artificial additives. Every KRUNCH cookie delivers honest, uncompromised nutrition that is remarkably gentle on sensitive systems. That satisfying bite isn't just a premium texture—it's the wholesome sound of a happier, healthier life.
features: No artificial colors, sweeteners, flavors & preservatives
Suitable for dogs of all breeds
All ingredients responsibly sourced fresh off the farm.
flags: Full ingredient list, storage, MRP and manufacturer are on a side panel that is not visible in any of the provided photos. Only the front-label key ingredients and net weight (300gm, front label) are recorded.
